startup:
FailAt 21
Assign Developer: SYS:Developer
MakeDir RAM:CEFProfile
Assign PROFILE: RAM:CEFProfile
Stack 1048576
Assign AROSTCP: SYS:System/Network/AROSTCP
Run <NIL: >RAM:AROSTCP-startup.log QUIET AROSTCP:C/AROSTCP
C:WaitForPort AROSTCP
C:CEFMemorySample before-host
Run >RAM:CEF-host.log Execute S:CEFHost-Run
C:CEFHostProbe wait
If WARN
Echo MEM171-host-unavailable >DEBUG:
Quit 20
EndIf
C:CEFMemorySample host-ready
Echo MEM171-cycle-start:1 >DEBUG:
C:CEFHostBrowser A "@SYS:CEF-cycle-url.txt" 1000 2000 primary
Echo MEM171-cycle-1-returned:$RC >DEBUG:
Wait 5
C:CEFHostProbe stats
C:CEFMemorySample cycle-01
C:CEFHostProbe stop
Echo MEM171-stop-returned:$RC >DEBUG:
C:CEFWaitFile T:CEFHost171.done
If WARN
Echo MEM171-host-exit-timeout >DEBUG:
Quit 20
EndIf
C:CEFMemorySample host-exited
Echo MEM171-finished >DEBUG:
Wait 3600
scope: One local-page browser lifecycle in one resident host; same A/primary profile on private FAT; no network fixture. Whole guest memory, not engine-only allocation.
